title: Retrospective analysis of body composition in patients with cholangiocellular carcinoma (CCC) before and after transarterial radioembolization (TARE)
summary:
Project title, version number, version date
Project title: Retrospective analysis of body composition in patients with cholangiocellular carcinoma (CCC) before and after transarterial radioembolization (TARE)
Version: 1.0
Date: 22 August 2025

Responsibilities
Principal Investigator:
Dr. med. univ. Dr. med. Thomas Dertnig
Institute of Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology and Neuroradiology
University Hospital Essen
Hufelandstr. 55, 45147 Essen, Germany
E-Mail: Thomas.Dertnig@uk-essen.de
Phone: +49 (0)201 723 82847
Institutions:
University Medicine Essen
Registration according to the Declaration of Helsinki:
Planned (purely retrospective, anonymized evaluation).

Data sources
CT datasets (abdomen and thorax, pre- and post-treatment) from the PACS of the Institute of Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology and Neuroradiology
Documentation from inpatient and outpatient stays related to TARE treatments
Tumor board protocols, interventional reports, laboratory values
Study period: 01 January 2000 to 01 August 2025
Patient cohort: approx. 70 patients with histologically confirmed cholangiocellular carcinoma (CCC) who underwent TARE

Biometry
Complete inclusion of all eligible cases within the study period
Expected sample size: approx. 70 cases
No formal sample size calculation (retrospective, exploratory)
Analyses:
Descriptive statistics
Kaplan–Meier analyses for OS
Comparison of pre- and post-treatment body composition values (paired tests)
Correlations of SI, MFI, VFI with survival and adverse events
Multivariate analyses to identify independent predictors

Data management & data protection
Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in research), § 27 BDSG
Retrospective, fully anonymized data evaluation
Deep learning analyses will be performed exclusively on pseudonymized CT datasets
Storage: encrypted on internal hospital servers, access restricted to the study team
No transfer to third parties without separate approval
No possibility of patient re-identification
conditions: Patients with histologically confirmed cholangiocellular carcinoma (CCC) who underwent TARE
Malignant neoplasm: Intrahepatic bile duct carcinoma

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Histologically confirmed cholangiocellular carcinoma (CCC)
TARE performed during the specified period at University Hospital Essen
Complete documentation of pre- and post-treatment CT datasets as well as clinical follow-up data
Exclusion criteria:
Incomplete documentation or missing CT data
